headline: A beach beneath a bridge. And that's just the start.
dek: Six memorable corners of the Amalfi Coast
editorial_intent: A more striking six-location Amalfi Coast visual story, with Fiordo bridge as the hook, a verified Sentiero degli Dei photo instead of generic town view, an aerial beach scene, and a new genuine Amalfi waterfront image.

caption:
There’s a beach tucked beneath a road bridge on Italy’s Amalfi Coast — and it’s only one of the places worth seeing. 🍋

📍 Fiordo di Furore — a turquoise cove framed by cliffs and an arched bridge.
📍 Ravello — garden terraces perched high above the coastline.
📍 Path of the Gods — mountain views above the sea near Praiano.
📍 Positano — tightly packed pastel houses above the sea.
📍 Amalfi Beach — swimmers and beach umbrellas viewed from above.
📍 Amalfi waterfront — buildings and boats beside the dramatic coast.

Which would you go to first? Save this for a future Italian escape.

Photos: Rolands Varsbergs, nella n., Christopher Pap de Pestény, Ian Mackey, Margo Evardson & Chloé Lefleur / Unsplash.
